content:
Apple has adjusted trade-in valuations for several iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch models, as well as some Android phones. Here are the latest values.

Apple today updated its trade-in valuation table, raising the trade-in price for the majority of products, with some devices receiving increases of nearly 30%. The company has also added several Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel and OnePlus models to the list.

Below are Apple's trade-in values as of August 6, 2026. All amounts represent the "maximum" trade-in price:
